question: Kamlesh offers the following two discount schemes to his customers on the sale of an article: (i) Two successive discounts of 25% and 5% (ii) Two successive discounts of 20% and 10% What is the difference between the selling price (in Rs.) of the article under these two discount schemes if its marked price is Rs. 1,000?
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price = Rs. 1,000

Discount scheme (i): Two successive discounts of 25% and 5%

Discount scheme (ii): Two successive discounts of 20% and 10%

**Formula Used:**

Final price after successive discounts = Marked price × (1 - Discount 1) × (1 - Discount 2)

**Calculation:**

For scheme (i):

Discount 1 = 25% = 0.25

Discount 2 = 5% = 0.05

Final price after scheme (i) = 1000 × (1 - 0.25) × (1 - 0.05)
